objs.name: policy
objs.description: Company-wide regulation and process at strategic level defining rules and organizational structure

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Document describing locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Document describing specific procedures within a framework, process sequence, and responsible persons

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Document detailing specific work steps, test instructions, and compliance criteria for sub-processes

objs.name: document
objs.description: Generic document object that can be of various types managed through the P&R system

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: Supplementary content attached to a document that does not follow the release cycle of the main document

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document that is released with the main document and affects its version

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposed amendment to an existing document managed separately from version history

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: System-generated request to review document validity before expiration

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: Request to invalidate and archive a document that no longer has validity

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: Request to re-validate and restore a previously invalidated document

objs.name: user
objs.description: System user with assigned roles and permissions for document management activities

objs.name: author
objs.description: User with creation and writing permissions on document content and details

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: Additional user with change rights on document content but no relevance in release workflow

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: User responsible for checking document content according to technical and formal aspects

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: User responsible for approving document release and distribution to readers

objs.name: reader
objs.description: User with view-only access to approved and released documents

objs.name: translator
objs.description: User authorized to translate released document content into another language

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Initial creation of a document in the system by attaching new information object with document type selection

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Modification of document content using integrated editing client and MS Office formats

evts.name: maintain_metadata
evts.description: Definition and update of document properties, attributes, and metadata through categorized fields

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatic system conversion of edited document to PDF format for web display

evts.name: submit_for_review
evts.description: Initiation of workflow-supported approval process by author or co-author

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Technical and formal checking of document content by assigned reviewers

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Final approval and publication of document by releaser with electronic signature

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatic publication of released document making it visible to addressed readers

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Creation of new version of valid released document with retention of previous data

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Marking of attachment as archived when no longer relevant to new document version

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Creation of proposed amendment to existing document without affecting content or version history

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: Integration of change proposal into new document version

evts.name: request_validity_extension
evts.description: System-generated request when document reaches 30 days before validity expiration

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Confirmation by releaser or document team that document validity is extended for additional period

evts.name: invalidate_document
evts.description: Declaration of document as out of force and revocation of user permissions except archive group

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Re-validation of previously invalidated document with restoration of metadata and authorizations

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Notification of users and user groups about new document version release via email

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Workflow task requesting users to actively confirm receipt and understanding of document

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: User confirmation of document acknowledgement through workflow task

o2o.description: Document can have supplementary additional information objects attached
Document can have controlled attachment objects released with it
Change proposal belongs to and is displayed within a specific document
Validity extension request is linked to the document being reviewed
Override request is created for a specific document to be invalidated
Override request can be created when document fails validity extension review
Reactivation request references a previously invalidated document
Co-authors are additional users assigned to same document as author
Author and reviewer are different persons to maintain dual control principle
Reviewers and releasers are assigned participants in document release process
Readers are assigned through distribution list to access approved documents

o2e.description: Event creates a new document object in the system
Event modifies the content of a document object
Event updates properties and metadata of a document object
Event converts document object to PDF format
Author performs the document creation event
Author or co-author initiates the review submission event
Author edits and implements change proposal event
Event submits document for workflow-supported approval
Reviewer performs technical and formal checking event
Reviewer participates in validity extension request event
Reviewer participates in document invalidation event
Releaser performs final approval and signature event
Releaser confirms validity extension event
Releaser approves document invalidation event
Event releases and publishes document object
Event makes document visible to addressed readers
Event creates new version of document object
Event marks attachment for archiving
Event creates change proposal object for document
Event integrates change proposal into document
Event generates validity extension request object
Event confirms extension of document validity
Event declares document out of force via override request
Event re-validates previously invalidated document
Event notifies users about document release
Reader receives workflow task to acknowledge document
Reader performs acknowledgement confirmation event
Event generates acknowledgement workflow task for document
Translator releases translated version of document
